sources.title: mimaapp/walkertext-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: WalkerText — on-device models Mirror of the two model files downloaded by the WalkerText Android app (com.mimaapp.captions) to create subtitles on the phone, without sending videos anywhere. The files are byte-identical copies of the originals; they are hosted here only so the app does not depend on someone else's repository.
